title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: Conditions are going downhill: base lowering and sun fading. Cloudbase is lowering. Kula Ag had about half sun over the last hour; cloud reaches all the way to the Summit. Upslope has run since about 07:45 at a light 4 mph, and thermals seem light. Trades are holding the shear line crossing Kula Highway between Pukalani and Kamehameha Schools, with no trade air on the lower west slope.
